# Arcanum

> Open-source, self-hosted WhatsApp gateway written in Go: one binary with a REST API, signed webhooks, built-in anti-ban and a web dashboard. MIT license.

Installing it for a user? Follow https://arcanumgateway.com.br/agent.txt exactly.

## Docs
- [Installation](https://arcanumgateway.com.br/en/installation/): every install method
- [Getting started](https://arcanumgateway.com.br/en/getting-started/)
- [Configuration](https://arcanumgateway.com.br/en/configuration/): all GATEWAY_* variables
- [API reference](https://arcanumgateway.com.br/en/api-reference/)
- [Webhooks](https://arcanumgateway.com.br/en/webhooks/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://arcanumgateway.com.br/en/troubleshooting/)
